records.outline: Slumped over the desk in Conductor's room on The Eternal, you slowly awaken in the early morning. Next to you, a girl is still writing. A new day begins, but it doesn't seem particularly pleasant...

records.outline: The final crew member has also returned to the train. You discuss the transportation plan, but you must set off with a short-handed crew due to the difficult financial situation. Late at night, you find Livia still pondering something in the carriage.
Shoggolith City is within sight, but a sudden, unexpected event disrupts the peaceful journey...
The looming threat has not been resolved, and the deadly danger continues to pursue you.

The enraged whale violently collides with the train. Confronting the strong winds, you decided to detach the carriage and point the turret at the Chaos Remain. Inside the cargo carriage, Rebis notices something...
The crisis has been averted, and The Eternal can safely continue its journey. A girl named Stella, a few kilometers away from the train, quietly departs.

Upon finally arriving outside Shoggolith City, Rebis, who was in the carriage, vanished without a trace. Faced with the Metal Billiard Ball she left behind, everyone is clueless. Furthermore, you still have not obtained any information about the Dream Station. At this moment, the forces from Shoggolith City contact you.

records.idCN: Ep1/对话11（修格里城-入城车站-主角）
records.outline: You are welcomed into the city as a hero. You are received and thanked by Mayor Jose of Shoggolith City. At night, the exhausted Fran and Eliot have already fallen asleep. In the moonlit carriage, you and Livia renew your long-standing promise.
records.path: story/Ep1/修格里城-入城车站（主角）

records.outline: After The Eternal is sent for repairs, you wander aimlessly in Shoggolith City and encounter a group of juveniles harassing a girl. Without hesitation, you rush forward to intervene.

It turns out that Songbird was here to strike a deal with the mobs, and you had accidentally got involved in this misunderstanding. Before parting ways, the friendly Miss Songbird drew a simple map of downtown Shoggolith.

While everyone was trying to raise funds, you were busy with identifying the Metal Billiard Ball. The train returned after two days, and everyone was delighted with the brand-new Eternal. Additionally, you received a mail from Mayor Jose...

records.idCN: Ep1/对话16（修格里城-黑月大酒店-主角）
records.outline: Mayor Jose hosted a banquet at Night Chains Hotel to honor you. He expressed a strong interest in the Metal Billiard Ball during a private chat.
records.path: story/Ep1/修格里城-黑月大酒店（主角）

records.outline: After declining the mayor's proposal, you discussed it with Livia on the way back. Meanwhile, in the mayor's office, Mayor Jose, who had confirmed that the billiard ball was related to the Citadel's Weapons, issued an order to seize it.

records.idCN: Ep1/对话19（修格里城-地铁入口）
records.outline: Carrying out the mayor's personal order, you arrive at the subway entrance used for transportation. Meanwhile, Walter, the leader of the MoleGang, received information from the mayor's secretary and was lying in ambush with his men...
Just as everyone was about to rest, an alarm suddenly went off. Numerous obstacles and armed personnel appeared on this secret route, and they are clearly targeting you...
You have defeated the first wave of ambushers but cannot contact any rescue teams. The retreat path has also been destroyed, leaving you with no choice but to move forward.

You continued to defeat enemies along the way, clearing barricades and opening the path. However, you couldn't shake the feeling that these enemies were stalling for time. What exactly were they planning?
As the barricades were gradually cleared, the railway finally became clear. At that moment, Walter appeared, driving a massive modified mech and blocking Livia and the others.
Livia and the others' attacks had almost no effect. Just as Walter was about to finish them, The Eternal roared through the vibrating tunnel...

The Eternal successfully left Shoggolith City. However, a squad from the BCRL Agency, who was acting on a mysterious tip-off, followed The Eternal, prompting the mayor to abandon his actions against them. The mayor seemed to know the identity of this mysterious helper...
In the Wilderness, a group of P.U.S. carriages, led by a girl named Shire and accompanied by a goose, is speeding toward you, and it appears they are after you...

records.outline: As you and Rebis board the train, Box "grandly" greets you.
Everyone gets ready to board the train after Rebis catches you using the Flee Alarm to scan luggage and makes fun of your "outdated trinket".

To celebrate the close shave you guys just had, your crew has a simple party on the train, but it doesn't seem like you're out of the woods yet. While you're planning the itinerary for after arriving at Mander Mine, you hear an explosion vaguely sounding from afar...

You unexpectedly reunite with your childhood friend Shizuru, who is now the captain of a BCRL execution team. Shizuru and her crew members board your train due to an anonymous tip-off. While the train crew find the tip-off suspicious, you still agree to cooperate with the team's investigation.

The train's driving restriction is lifted after the search. According to the intel shared by Shizuru, you all surmise that there may be a connection between the MoleGang's surprise attack and the weird anonymous tip-off.

The train has only just arrived at Mander Mine when Peter Hwang, the person in charge here, shows up right in time. From the implicative way he speaks, you sense that Mayor Jose must have a hand in all your recent troubles.

At the BCRL Agency, upon learning that there have been multiple wandering "Marauders" around the mine, and the number of Chaos Remains has also somehow increased, your crew offers to lend a hand by taking the commission.

Suddenly, The Eternal receives an emergency SOS call. What's strange is that the call is coming from a ship that disappeared from the seaport many years ago. At once, Team Ratel decides to head over to check it out. You suggest taking them there on the train for safety's sake.
The "Marauders" are spotted in the rain, shockingly fiddling with the modified Earth Union military equipment. Evidently, someone will have to go forward and stop them...

records.idCN: Ep2/对话09（荒原帝王号-操作室）
records.outline: It goes without saying that something must be going on for these Marauders, who usually hang around Shoggolith, to appear here out of the blue...
After slipping past the horde of Marauders, the three of you successfully board the Wilderness King.
It is when you all finally get to the deepest part of the engineering platform, where you run into Wilderness King himself...
The defeated Wilderness King flees for his life with you guys hot on his heels.

records.idCN: Ep2/对话13（荒原帝王号-总控室）
records.outline: At the main control room, your group manages to restrain Wilderness King, take control of the ship, and successfully rescue two unconscious girls.
However, Wilderness King, seemingly fearful of something, refuses to cooperate with your interrogation, leaving you with no answers.

While everyone on the train falls into a deep sleep under the effects of certain ascension abilities, you, who's surprisingly immune, overhear the conversation between Wilderness King and an uninvited guest named Hayabusa. After Hayabusa disappears into thin air, Livia comes to let you know that the two girls have awakened.

The awakened girls hardly remember anything, so you can only speculate on what happened based on their memory fragments. While you're determined to help the two girls, Shizuru is concerned that you might put yourself in even more danger if you do, so you promise to protect yourself first. Under the flowing lights, you have all grown up to become the people you aspired to be.
Once Shizuru takes Wilderness King and the two girls away, your crew, with nothing on the agenda for the time being, decides to head out and look for the food that the girls crave for.
The fried chicken shop's manager tells you that "Happy Dreams Meal" was already discontinued about eight years ago, but upon hearing about your intent, he generously gives you the recipe for it.
All of you come to an incredulous conclusion after connecting the dots: The two girls were passengers of the Phildridge who inexplicably survived and traveled to the present.

The girls gradually recover their memories as they dig into the fried chicken. Outside the carriage, Shizuru informs you of the commander-in-chief's order: Send the two girls to be isolated in Anita Tech' office under the B.C.R.L.'s supervision. However, Shizuru doesn't seem to be on board with this plan.
As you and Livia chew over why the B.C.R.L. is afraid of Ascenders mutating, Shizuru sends over a piece of news: Wilderness King and the twins have gone missing...
Facing the surge of Chaos Remains on the road, your group directs all attention to breaking through them.
You all board the Phiggy after the tough battle. Although the ship's resonance pollution causes you tremendous physical pressure, you still insist on going forward with the others.
Turns out, the twins have used their ascension abilities to take Wilderness King hostage all the way here. Feverishly, they keep searching the ship for survivors...

In the end, in the captain's cabin, the twins see the "chief mate" and their mother, who has also become a Deep Sleeper. Amid the screeches of monsters comes a gunshot that wrecks their last sweet dream...

Many years ago, when the Phiggy was about to be engulfed by resonance, the twins managed to survive, as they were sent to the core of the Morphic Field. While all of you struggle to fight against the Deep Sleepers, two Anita members arrive at the most critical juncture for assistance...

Yet, just as you finally catch a breath, a massive Chaos Remain named "Disciple" materializes right in front of your group. You guys need to break through from an area with fewer Chaos Remains before it attacks.

However, with a berserk Chaos Remain ahead of you, you all are trapped. At this moment, "Mom", who is supposed to be dead, unexpectedly sacrifices herself to protect the twins, fulfilling a mother's final duty. Rebis, who you haven't seen in a long time, then emerges out of nowhere, and under her guidance, you take out that billiard ball, hoping it can bring miracles.

records.outline: Shizuru and the two sisters bid farewell to Conductor. The Citadel agrees to take them to the nearest Climber in Cape City. As we say goodbye, Shizuru assures us that we will visit the two sisters together someday.

You arrive at COLUMBA to pick up new commission orders. Livia finds a profitable order to visit the gold mine, but it has already been "reserved" by a familiar face (the "adversary"). Regardless of the disappointment, Conductor may only look for other work. Just then, the supervisor informs you about the ONEderland and leads you to locate the mine owner.

records.idCN: Ep3/对话5（曼德矿场-管理中心）
records.outline: Peter wishes to be guided to the ONEderland, and despite your reservations about his generosity, you decide to take the train on this adventure.
The train sets off. Based on the intel received, you've got to stay alert for the criminal group P.U.S. operating in the area.
Peter tells you about the history of Shoggolith City, revealing that someone else is responsible for the train robbery case, and this person seems to be Peter's reason for undertaking this journey...
A large number of Nugget Mechs block the entrance to the ONEderland, apparently thinking you're an invader.

After dealing with the robots, you finally manage to enter the ONEderland smoothly. The manager here is a robot named "Gold", which is precisely the purpose of Peter's journey, and he hopes you can help locate it together.
This was once a gold mining site and might be regarded as the origin of the ONEderland.

records.idCN: Ep3/交互3（淘金乐园-矿洞入口）
records.outline: The moss-covered, plain, sealed-off entrance to the mine gives off an eerie atmosphere.
The rundown bistro has long since lost its once-vibrant atmosphere, and the youthful singers who formerly graced the main stage are now nonexistent.
The sole morphic field stabilizer in the ONEderland is located in the center of the land.

No one has yet set foot in the ONEderland's Management Center. Before visiting, Conductor asks Peter a question that silences him for a long time. Meawhile, Shire and the P.U.S. are talking with Miss Gold, the manager here and their employer, in the Management Center.
As the morphic field stabilizer successfully operates, Gold returns to normal. When everything settles down, you and the P.U.S. decide to spend the night here.

records.idCN: Ep1/对话18（修格里城-商会-主角）
records.outline: Again, you run across Miss Songbird at the Shoggolith CoC. This time, she cautions you about the mayor.
You should probably listen to Livia's advice if you want to know how to make more money via the Trading Center.

At the door of the Trading Center, you accidentally run into Simon, an old classmate who views himself as your adversary and challenges you. Following his persistent pursuit, you have decided to take on this advantageous but challenging endeavour.

As one round of competition is about to end, Simon, who refuses to admit defeat, promptly challenges you to a second round. It seems like you'll have to be more aggressive if you don't want him to fantasize about winning.

You learned from Simon's return that he had reserved that order from the Shoggolith CoC in advance. Simon, who is falling behind in the competition and is getting frustrated, decides on the goal amount for the next round.

Simon seems deeply affected. After a few conversations with him, you begin to see the sincerity behind his exaggerated words and actions. Nevertheless, you and Simon are still engaged in a fierce rivalry...
You and Livia fight hard against the enemies. Nearby, Rina Von is puzzled about why bring someone like you without ascension abilities, but Rebis calls you the "star of the show".
The first assessment has been completed successfully.

records.outline: The grey-haired girl's identity seems uncommon. While you attempt to unravel the mystery, the juveniles reappeared.

Peter speaks to you about the future of the ONEderland. He is keen on turning it into a tourist hotspot and hopes to collaborate with you on its development. However, he needs you to escort him and ten Nugget Mechs needing repair back to Mander Mine right now.

As early risers, you and Livia meet with Shire, who has been waiting for you. After some friendly banter, Shire bids you farewell and informs you that Peter is handling things in the hall while waiting for you.

Young Peter and Baxter once travelled to ONEderland, where they could enter the city with the help of Gold after earning enough money. Nevertheless, Gold turned down Peter's invitation. However, at this very moment, Gold is raving insane, vehemently fighting for the survival of ONEderland. Peter changes his mind about taking Gold away. Just then, communicator rings, and you bring good news.
To restore Gold's morphic field stability, Akira and Yer need an assistant to help repair the morphic field stabilizer. Luckily, you're capable of fulfilling that role.

Peter eventually reveals his true purpose: to take Gold from here. However, with the morphic field stabilizer damaged, Gold spirals out of control. As everyone is at a loss, Akira and Yer, whom you once met on the Phiggy, appear and offer their assistance. At first glance, it seems like everything is working fine, but then Gold starts acting extremely strangely...

The Chaos Remains scatter, regrouping in another direction. When you come to your senses, the P.U.S. is nowhere to be found. Back on the train, you prepare to approach Peter Hwang to inquire if Shire's appearance is connected to him.
Shire, who escaped the carriage, rallies the P.U.S. to fight beside you during the crisis.
You engage in a fierce battle. Just as Shire attempts to flee from the isolation chamber, Peter proposes a deal to her.

Shire sneaks into the train and accidentally stumbles upon you while you're resting. After capturing Shire, you've learned why she launched the attack. After a series of events, you find yourself alone with Livia and decide to share your dream about her earlier. As you both ponder its significance, an alarm suddenly interrupts your thoughts.
The weakened P.U.S. forces retreat as their attacks prove ineffective. Feeling exhausted, you decided to take a short break in Conductor's room.
The train is attacked by the P.U.S., and you quickly devise a strategy to counter it.
Upon awakening, you discover that you and your companions have returned to Mander Mine, where a fresh day has started.
As Box scans the surroundings, countless Chaos Remains are closing in on the train. You quickly hit the brakes, ready to disembark with your comrades and face them head-on.

records.outline: Miss Moirai from COLUMBA informed you of an event showcasing the latest Black Tea in Shoggolith, and you decided to go.
Slumped over the desk in Conductor's room on The Eternal, you slowly awaken in the early morning. Next to you, a girl is still writing. A new day begins, but it doesn't seem particularly pleasant...
The train crew taste the new gen Black Tea together. While the rest of the train crew rave about it, you and Livia are the only ones who don't seem to enjoy it.
The Empire travellers find a familiar aroma in a foreign milk tea shop.
In your quest to uncover the origin of Black Tea, you visit the Shoggolith City Trading Center, where Moirai has offered to assist you.
Meanwhile, Arcana and Charlotte are attempting to identify the source of the strange scented source throughout the city.
A member of the Citadel, known as Katas, has arrived in the Bonfire City to conduct an investigation...
Late at night, Moirai hands a package containing BOX to a mysterious figure wearing a mask. You will follow the signal from BOX to find your target.
You arrive at a mysterious factory. Following the footprints, you find the enemies within.

Based on their attire, you realize the enemies you defeated are from the MoleGang. As you venture deeper into the factory, you find that the materials for making the Black Tea are actually the limbs of the Chaos Remains.
A talking mole suddenly emerges, and you managed to extract a wealth of information from it.
After defeating Mole, a domesticated Chaos Remain suddenly charges at you.
After defeating the Chaos Remains, the BCRL Agency arrives at the scene. Julian arrests Mole and rewards you. It's also time to part ways with Katas.

You return to Freeport Ⅶ, where Fran and Eliot decide to take advantage of the holiday to go out and explore. At Julian's invitation, you visit the destruction site of the Black Tea with Livia. At the port, you meet Arcana from Mundus, who explains how to handle the Black Tea.
Moirai arrives at the milk tea shop in Freeport Ⅶ, asking Ruperto to buy her a milk tea.
You arrive at Viburnum, and Arina updates you about the other side of the events and the internal strife within the Night Chains.
Verlaine and her group arrive at KEEP Fried Chicken but realize they've come to the wrong place.
You guys accept Katas' invitation and arrive at a café. The Katas that greets you is totally unlike the one you know.
While investigating the New Gen Black Tea, you decided to cooperate with Katas.
As soon as you step out of the BCRL Agency, you are suddenly attacked by oddballs descending from the sky...
Due to recent anomalies, Julian from the BCRL Agency asks you to investigate the source of the bizarre incidents related to the Black Tea.
A large crowd is causing trouble in front of the BCRL Agency, and you rush to help.
Besides you and Livia, the behavior of the train crew members who drank the New Gen Black Tea is extremely unusual.
In the rest area, you briefly encounter Wensheng, the manager of Night Chains Hotel. Something is occurring in the city without your knowledge...

records.idCN: 活动1期-红茶战争/先行预热
records.outline: After receiving a mail from Simon, you met with him and received valuable information about the upcoming launch of a new brand of black tea in Shoggolith City.

The train crew is preparing to set out again now that everyone is well-rested after returning from ONEderland. All of a sudden, you receive Shizuru's message and learn that someone has leaked out the matter concerning Phildridge, and you might be charged with baseless charges for using the billiard ball.
You and your crew members analyze the situation, then decide to inquire about the billiard ball's mystery from Anfiya. Anfiya suggests you head to Freeport Ⅶ to seek help from her teacher.

On the way to Freeport Ⅶ, you pull yourself together and start chewing over who could be behind the leaked news with Livia. The mysterious intruder you previously saw at Mander Mine abruptly comes to mind...

Your crew encounters a Gardener named Stella at the entrance of the Metaphysical Particles Institute. She turns out to be the person who lured the whale away from outside Shoggolith City back then, and she appears to have some ideas about your plight.
After Stella's experiment is done, she says the limited circumstances make it hard to continue examining it. At this moment, an unknown woman passes by, and Stella seems to know her...
The unknown woman is an exceptional researcher named Nicola, according to Stella. Nicola also agrees to help you out, but she seems peculiar and standoffish, which doesn't make her feel trustworthy.
Per Nicola's request, your crew gives her a ride to the CDCA Bureau. Her unwillingness to make conversation leaves you guys feeling at a loss. Out of the blue, hostile enemies emerge right ahead.
Eliot discovers Nicola is actually playing video games, which is bewildering, to say the least. Meanwhile, the unexpected enemies ahead of the train are revealed to be remnants of Northern Alliance.
Seeing as the train is nearing the destination, you elect to inform Nicola about it, but without warning, she yanks you down, claiming it's merely her rumination habit.
The abrupt appearance of Northern Alliance's remnants here naturally fills your crew with plenty of questions.
Nicola hands you an instrument and instructs all of you to collect data at the location she specified. You all realize that she isn't that hard to get along with, after all.
In case B.C.R.L. sets out to arrest your crew, Eliot suggests going to a clothing store to get new clothes as a disguise.

You guys become acquainted with Margiela, the clothing store owner, who enthusiastically recommends several cosplay costumes to you all. In the meantime, Team Ratel has also arrived at the CDCA Bureau...

After completing the task given by Nicola, all of you are about to head back for the night, only to be harassed by a couple of Night Chains members. At this time, Songbird shows up out of nowhere and helps you out of the situation, and you learn about a scary rumor involving Nicola from her.

Nicola's analysis makes you suspect that the cargo Rebis previously commissioned you to deliver may be connected with the Reality Stabilizer's malfunctioning. As your crew walks on the street, a familiar young woman suddenly sneaks up on you.

The person sneaking up on you guys turns out to be Katas. Just as the fight is about to take a turn for the worse, an unknown woman comes forward and stops it. Shockingly, she is someone whom Livia knows...

Songbird's words have made you guys even more wary of Nicola. To your shock, Nicola sees through your thoughts right away and doesn't mind your attitude at all. She tells you the considerations behind her actions and wants you to collect data a second time.
Stay aware and prepare to face upcoming allies... and enemies.
Your group decides to step in and stop those Night Chains members who are acting erratically.
The data is successfully collected by you all at the second coordinate point.
While collecting data, your crew notices some commotion on the streets.

Meanwhile, Livia and the others have also successfully completed their task, and Connor expresses her wish that Livia returns to the Empire with her. Though utterly shocked, Livia turns Connor down without any hesitation.

As promised, your crew convenes at Pupil's Fashion Wear, and Margiela tells you the truth behind Night Chains' actions. You agree to everyone's request and decide to get them out of the CDCA Bureau on The Eternal.
You tell Nicola about the details of Rebis' order, giving Nicola more insight. Suddenly, enemies pop up ahead of the train's path.
Margiela exerts immense power against the horde of enemies, astounding all the Empire people present.
Without warning, Chaos Remains also swarm forward at this juncture. Nicola plans to let you guys continue going forward while she deals with them alone.
Right as you all finally break through the encirclement, Northern Alliance deploys formidable mechas to join the battle.
The mechas still have one last ounce of power left after being knocked down, to your consternation. At the nick of time, Connor puts her life on the line and steps forward...
Connor's life is threatened, and yet the Chaos Remains keep coming unceasingly. You panic upon sensing their hatred toward you, but Nicola saves you.
In an inconspicuous spot, an enigmatic young man named Hayabusa is observing every move of yours. How exactly is he related to Songbird and this series of events?
As it turns out, Connor and Livia used to be companions, and your crew's misunderstanding with Katas' group is also resolved.
All of a sudden, you receive Nicola's message. She wants you to return to The Eternal at once. Connor offers to give you all a ride back on her motorcycle.
Thanks to Connor riding at virtually insane speeds, you guys successfully make it back in the time requested by Nicola.
You return to the carriage to meet Nicola, and Haruka expresses her concern.
You and two of your guard crew members tag along with Nicola to the underground database. The hacker is revealed to be a member of Night Chains.
While your operation is going swimmingly, Katas suspects Nicola only sent her group away out of fear of Katas' identity as a Citadel member.
You guys bump into Night Chains' execution team. Surprisingly, the clothing store owner you briefly met earlier is also a member of Night Chains.

You inform your crew about the decision to work together with Nicola. Following Nicola's instruction, all of you split up into two teams to separately deal with the issues of the underground database being hacked and the Chaos Remains that have congregated.

There seems to be discord within Night Chains' execution team, but your group leaves without getting involved. Margiela, who doesn't seem to have any ill will toward you, says she has something to tell you.
Margiela's words leave you in total disbelief. After much contemplation, you opt to let Nicola in on what you just heard.
Connor and friends make up their minds to help your crew upon learning about your predicament.
In a surprise twist of events, Nicola is found to be the designer of The Eternal's engine. The things you two chat about almost seem endless.
Miss Vostok of the launch base has introduced the primary objective of this project to you.
You chance upon Tennie in the milk tea store again and find out her reason for being here. She seems to have participated in the reconstruction work out of respect for the staff of the launch center.
At the BCRL Agency, you encounter Miss Tennie from Mander Mine and find out she is also participating in this project.
The reconstruction of the launch center's bridge is about to be completed. Vostok promises that The Eternal has already earned the right to visit the launch center.
The launch center's bridge is officially reconstructed! Celebrate the joy of connecting new stations with Vostok through a toast of Pear Soda!
You learn from Miss Julian that the details of the assistance project can be obtained from Miss Vostok, Anita's project manager, in Freeport Ⅶ.

With Nicola by your side, you manage to clear your name at BCRL Agency, but Heinrich reveals some above and beyond unexpected information.
After the initial investigation, you and the others temporarily go separate ways. You lead your train crew to the Wilderness Station to look into a special situation.
When you arrive at Wilderness Station, you encounter an unusually large amount of Chaos Remains.
You meet Anfiya and ask for her help to investigate whether these anomalies are connected to Connor's disappearance.
You realize that the direction you are heading aligns with the path to ONEderland.
After hearing about your experiences at the CDCA Bureau, Anfiya suggests that you seek help from the Anita Launch Center and the Weapon Factory.
You can't find the answers you were looking for at the launch center, but Anfiya does share with you the history of the Phildridge.
You arrive at the Anita Weapon Factory.
You successfully tour the Weapon Factory and observe the challenges Anfiya faces during social interactions.
Anfiya receives an unexpected message from BCRL, requesting a meeting at the factory entrance.
When no one from BCRL shows up, you realize it's a trap.
In a moment of desperation, Eliade, the Gardener mentor appears and rescues you.
After a brief rest, Eliade visits the Eternal and explains the reason for his appearance.
Eliade reveals the truth about the Old Freeport Ⅶ incident to you.
Upon learning the truth, Anfiya's face turns pale, and Eliade asks you to look after her.
Outside a room, you find Anfiya's inseparable friend, White Birch.
With your support, Anfiya musters the courage to share her experiences for the first time.
From her account, you seem to uncover clues about the mastermind behind the events.
You and Livia decide to follow up on the clues and seek out Eliade's help.
As the train is about to depart, Anfiya arrives at the station.
Up ahead on the railway track, you come across an unexpected person.
The awakened Connor behaves erratically and attackes Anfiya.
Connor has transformed into a Deep Sleeper, leaving you no choice but to defeat her.
In the midst of the chaos, Rebis suddenly appears and captures the culprit, Nikita.
You demand an explanation from Rebis, suspecting she is still hiding something, while Nikita's motives continue to intrigue you.
The cunning Nikita tries to flee, but Anfiya blocks her off, only enraging her further.
As the situation reaches a critical point, Rebis' two students arrive just in time.
Nikita receives assistance from unknown allies and manages to escape, but she leaves something behind...
Before fleeing, Nikita forcibly triggers Connor's second transformation into a Deep Sleeper...
Confronted by an old friend and the one she has sworn to protect, Livia makes her choice.
Livia personally delivers a fatal blow to Connor, and witnessing this, Rebis appears to recall memories of Livia's mother.

records.outline: Returning to the Eternal, you arrive at the familiar conductor's room... Everything is so familiar to you. Welcome back, Conductor!
The crew of the Eternal gather to receive a quest personally assigned by President Medici.
Upon arriving at Cape City, the atmosphere is unlike any other Bonfire Cities...
The COLUMBA receptionist in Cape City informs us that the destination of this journey is the legendary Mirage Island.
Upon arriving at the BCRL Agency in Cape City, we encounter someone unexpected.
The mayor of Cape City personally greets us—why is there a cat here?
Preparations are complete, and with new outfits on, it's time to set off for the island!
Finally arrived at Mirage Island, and the first person I meet is... Shizuru?
We're met by Sharkbert, the administrator sent by COLUMBA, and start working on building the resort.
Simon, my self-proclaimed rival, makes another appearance, and this time the competition is about building a resort!
Although we're staying in tents for now, just being with the crew of the Eternal brings me happiness.
As the sudden threat of Chaos Remains looms, an unexpected person appears...
Why is Arina here?
It seems some strange people have mingled in among the guests.
Our residence has been upgraded again—it's time to reward Livia for all her hard work.
Let's create even more wonderful memories with Livia.
It's also time to upgrade the resort's facilities to boost its competitiveness.
Arina, who rarely opens up, has finally done so, and it feels like I'm getting closer to her...
Looters have attacked, but what are they really after...?
Everyone is thrilled with the upgraded hut!
The newly added noodle stand not only meets the customers' needs but also stirs up memories of home.
While discussing Simon's movements, we realize he's also keeping an eye on the Looters.
A face-to-face conversation with Simon—what exactly is our relationship?
We gather more clues from Simon, but the puzzle only deepens.
After all our hard work, we've finally created our "second home" on the island.
During a conversation with Shizuru about the past, I uncover her true feelings but just then, something strange happens...
Arina and Livia arrive—what exactly has happened?
At this point, the only option is to keep moving forward.
Livia tells us that all of this might be connected to the Empire.
Shizuru steps forward, moving toward "the position she believes is right for her."
After defeating the mysterious Deep Sleeper, we discover several murals...
Is this the monster sealed on Mirage Island? Can we really defeat it?
The self-proclaimed Dreamweaver reveals everything.
Regardless of everything, we eventually have to return to our daily lives.

While unwinding on the train with your crew mates, you learn of intruders breaking into Mander Vault over the radio. Shortly after, the mayor of Cape City personally tasks you with delivering his collections.
Accompanied by Livia, you set off to Mander Vault, retrieving the gems belonging to Mayor Aleister.
Upon handing over the suitcase with the gems, you realize the staff has mistaken it for another suitcase.
Eager to reclaim the gems, you make your way to the BCRL Agency in Cape City, seeking assistance from Shizuru.
In your quest to recover the gems, you decide to ask Arina for information. Later, a mysterious woman named Cecil crosses your path in Viburnum, and Arina eventually provides you with clues.
Near Viburnum, you are ambushed by members of Fluffy Union. Just as they are about to grab the suitcase, a Citadel member you met at the vault steps in to help.
The Citadel member Ithos mistakes you for meddling with his belongings. In the midst of the tension, Lissandra steps in to aid you.
Lissandra answers your questions and discloses Citadel's upcoming ritual to select an "Angel."
It turns out that Cecil is the mastermind behind the Fluffy Union. It appears that the Night Chains members are also eyeing the Omniscopic Gaze.
In the Climber, Lissandra is surprised to find out that the Omniscopic Gaze has chosen Livia as the new candidate, with Livia herself seemingly interested...
You are overwhelmed by conflicting emotions when you sense Livia's hesitation. Noticing this, Fran and Eliot step in to soothe your worries.
Encouraged by Fran, you temporarily set aside your emotional turmoil, committed to gathering more information about Angels from Ithos.
After agreeing to Ithos's terms, you learn that the secrets about angels are hidden within the Confluence Tower.

Your efforts to find a way into the tower prove futile. Just when you are feeling stuck, you come across Raziel, a Citadel member. While helping her, you and Livia manage to ease the tension between you.
You ask Raziel about the Confluence Tower's administrator, but she refuses to help.
Raziel turns out to be the administrator of the Confluence Tower. After hearing you out, she has a change of heart and offers to guide you to the tower.
With Raziel's guidance, you gain access to the Confluence Tower, where she unveils the harsh truth behind the Angel Project.
Inside the tower, you meet Jalhay, a young girl who has fallen victim to the Angelic tech. Your conversation with her deepens your understanding of the Angels.
As you are about to leave the Climber, you are summoned by BCRL. However, you sense that something is off about the situation.
You receive help from Ithos and delve deeper into the culprit's intentions and Ithos's personal motives. Ithos mentions that Raziel has something crucial to share with you.
Raziel tasks you with retrieving a gift for Jalhay from Shoggolith City. Her words reveal her deep care for Jalhay's well-being.
Upon obtaining the gift from the Shoggolith Trading Center, you notice peculiar gem shards hidden within the envelope.
Raziel shares with you the deep bond she once had with Lissandra.
You turn down Lissandra's request, and she respects your choice. Meanwhile, a robot riot occurs in the Climber.
You hand the gift to Jalhay, but she presses you about her sister Harle, and it seems Jalhay realizes something, becoming increasingly unstable...
When you are overwhelmed by the frenzied Jalhay, a strange Angel appears, standing firm to shield you with unwavering resolve.
Just as the clash between Ushana and Jalhay reaches a stalemate, Ithos intervenes to restore order.
Through Ithos, you discover that Raziel manipulated the ritual's outcome and decided to become an Angel herself. You hasten to Cape City, intent on meeting Raziel for one last time.
Your attempt to bid farewell to Raziel ends in failure. From Lissandra's account, you uncover the full story, delving into the inner struggles of Raziel and Lissandra.
Lissandra, the fair and honorable judge, is powerless to prevent Raziel's descent down a starkly different path, watching helplessly as she strays.
The ONEderland Hotel has been fully renovated, and Peter Hwang has invited you for a trial experience. Encouraged by Livia, you decide to enjoy a personal vacation.
Alcyon, the representative of Night Chains, has invited you to a detective game, and Valentine emerges victorious.
You overhear a conversation between Songbird and Alcyon. Further inquiry reveals that Songbird intends to find Mr. Calvin's legacy within the hotel.
Pranked by Songbird, you decide to confront her, but you notice her unusual demeanor...
Upon arriving at the ONEderland Hotel, you notice a suspicious group at the entrance. Thankfully, another person steps in to resolve the situation.
You run into Pelota and Valentine, who are also guests at the hotel. During a tour led by Peter Hwang, you encounter the mysterious Songbird once more.
The second round is a treasure hunt, but the cryptic message seems too strange to decipher. However, Songbird appears to have insider knowledge and easily decodes it.
Valentine remains unsettled by the cryptic message from the second round. During the third round, you have the chance to learn something new from Livia...
Valentine seems to have something on her mind. When you open the door, you are met with a disquieting resonance...
Mr. Storyteller suggests that deciphering the cryptic message may lead to a way out. After some discussion, you decide to explore the hotel's interior.
Upon reaching the hotel room, Songbird parts ways with you, and you lose track of her.
Pelota has disappeared within the maze, leaving you to continue exploring alone.
In the amusement park, you come across a swarm of Chaos Remains. Valentine steps forward to confront them, shielding you behind her.
After overcoming various challenges, you reunite and learn from Mr. Storyteller about Alcyon's plan to reconstruct the Wishing Tower.
When you return to the ritual room, you encounter the resurrected Alcyon, who reveals the hotel's hidden past.
You find yourself unable to truly defeat Alcyon, and your stamina is wasted in vain...
Just as you're exhausted, a message from Livia arrives in time, and Rebis, having reunited with her, suggests a solution.
Through your combined efforts, you successfully resolve the ongoing crisis.
You need to speak with him, and he is waiting for you. It is time to unmask him.
Source Citadel tells us that they will be sending one of their members to accompany us to our meeting with Jalhay.
We plan to take the device to the Apoaster Bridge for repair. Nayuta tells us about the Apoaster Bridge's situation.
At the Apoaster Bridge, we meet Chelsea, the administrator of this place, and "Butler" the investor. They're both shrouded in mysteries.
Besides the technician, we also happen to meet Night Chains executor Surya who came along. He tells us about how the projection works.
Chelsea protects me from Chaos Remains, but she's still brooding over Raziel's matter...
Chelsea fails to get the answer she wants from Raziel's projection, and Surya tells me the projection isn't malfunctioning.
Nayuta can relate to Chelsea's feelings. He tells me about his past. As it turns out, he used to be as lost as Chelsea...
I tell Jalhay the truth. Realizing that she will never get to see Raziel again, she sheds tears for the first time...
Nayuta makes me the custodian of Jalhay. Before leaving, he discovers that "Butler" is actually associated with the Ascension.
Accompanied by Nayuta, we meet Jalhay again. She seeks my help to fix the projector Raziel left in the Confluence Tower.
I meet Stella in a café. She is watching the commercial for the game "White Film" distractedly. She tells me about a friend of hers who's an idol.
Stella says this friend of hers has been fretting over her idol career and an odd "stalker." There seems to be some secrets behind this... I promise to help the idol.
I meet the idol STELLA. She seems at a complete loss for how to continue being an idol. As such, I decide to take her to the seaside to clear her head!
In the cold breeze on the esplanade, we have a heart-to-heart chat. STELLA opens up about her "truth", while I let her know that I'll support her no matter who she chooses to be.
We defeat the attacker, who surprises me with her true identity. Yet, Stella seems to have seen this coming.
We arrive at the film set in one piece. Stella tells me she has figured out how to deal with her idol job. This star will continue to shine on her path.

An enormous monster appears near Ranshin City. BCRL and Night Chains work together to fight against it. Ranshin's communication with the outside world is cut off. The whole city is a forsaken island now...
Unknown to anyone, a young lady appears on the train out of thin air, and the first thing she does upon waking up is to attack?
Unknown to anyone, a young lady appears on the train out of thin air, and the first thing she does upon waking up is to attack?
Heinrich tells us that Ranshin City has been invaded by a monster and has since been uncontactable. We head toward Yunxiu Bridge which is nearest to Ranshin City to find out more.
After conversing with Yusong, we learn that the BCRL Agency's Captain Fushimi, who withdrew from Ranshin City to here, is currently resting.

After hearing Fushimi describe Ranshin City's situation, Mumei is certain that the monster is from her world. To ensure the safety of the route to Ranshin City, Mumei, my crew, and BCRL decide to work together...
Within a magnificent abode in Ranshin City, a conspiracy is brewing.
We arrive at Ranshin City, and Mumei finally encounters her companion Ikoma. But before they can catch up with each other, the news of Deepsleep Kabanes coming hits...
After fighting alongside Ikoma in battle, we notice that there's a huge difference in the enemies than those encountered before.
Mumei and Ikoma share their experiences with each other. I hear from Ikoma about Yoizuki's so-called "sheltering" for those aboard Koutetsujou, but discover the discrepancies.
Yoizuki's guard comes to deliver a letter from Ayame that reveals unsettling information. It appears there might be a huge conspiracy brewing within Ranshin City.
Ikoma and Mumei invite me to stroll along Ranshin City. After having cup noodles, they come clean about their "secret."
Aoba brings astounding news. Although we have different objectives, it seems that working together is the only way to stop Yoizuki.
As we frets over how to turn things around, the fused entity reemerges in Ranshin City. But this time...
At the sight of Aoba who has now become the core of the fused entity, Mumei appears to make up her mind about something.
At the sight of Aoba who has now become the core of the fused entity, Mumei appears to make up her mind about something.
With everyone working as a team, the crisis is finally resolved. Yoizuki will have to face punishment from Ranshin City's governor, Toki.
Things come to a close. We bring good news to the Koutetsujou crew who are still temporarily living in Ranshin City...

records.outline: As the representative of Night Chains, I meet with the administrative officer of Citadel, Rina Von. It seems Cecil had a conflict with Ushana.
Under my suggestion, we decide to first go to the Confluence Tower to find a method to heal Cecil's wound.
I learn about the event from Ushana's perpective. Raziel's hologram tells me about Ushana's story, and I learn that Joshua has the potion to heal Cecil.
I inform Rina Von about what I have learned, but since Joshua comes and goes freely, finding them is not easy.
Raziel's hologram shows me Ushana's past, and it seems I now understand why Ushana calls me "Master Savior."
We arrive at ONEderland, but there is no trace of Joshua. According to Nugget Mechs, they left not long ago, so maybe we can still catch up with them.
Livia and I set off in the Basilisk and finally discover Joshua in the desert. They seem to be unconscious, and a large number of Chaos Remains have surrounded us...
We successfully rescued Joshua, who had collapsed in the desert, but the Chaos Remains surround us again.
Livia faces the threat alone while Joshua is still unconscious. In a critical moment, Ushana reveals extraordinary power to save us.
Joshua tells me that the Twirly Whirly is not in their hands. After some back-and-forth, this quirky Angel agrees to help us find the item.
Joshua guides us to a mysterious station, Tattle Station, where we see the birthplace of Angels, Haima Zaria, and hear the story behind it.
We meet Dustin, with whom we had a past connection. Based on his attitude, I realize things are somewhat complicated...
Ushana is emotional, as if she has sensed things. At the same time, I notice the gaze that has been watching me for who knows how long...
While unconscious, I seem to see memories that don't belong to me. When I wake up again, all of us are somehow already within Haima Zaria...
We finally find the core of Haima Zaria — the Mind Buoy. However, what will be waiting next...?
She wakes up, but is no longer the one we knew.
Whose memory am I watching?
Having returned from Unbewusstes, I hear about Ushana's sacrifice from Joshua and also come to a decision.
Before heading to battle, I learn from the Angel about their motive.
My companions have all been defeated. Joshua no longer has an excuse to step aside.
"How ironic... You... of all people..."
Ushana had a long dream. In the dream, Master Savior found her.
Dustin and Joshua put forward various proposals to a mysterious person. Will the Citadel change from now on?

records.idCN: 乘员逸闻/莱卡吉亚-肩上的自由/对话ARC7-3

records.idCN: 乘员逸闻/莱卡吉亚-肩上的自由/对话ARC7-4
records.outline: I reluctantly accept Reizia's invitation to patrol the vicinity. Lycagia confides in me that today's main task is to deliver a special document to the heads of various facilities, and the issuance and implementation of this document have encountered a lot of obstacles.

records.idCN: 乘员逸闻/莱卡吉亚-肩上的自由/对话ARC7-5

records.idCN: 乘员逸闻/莱卡吉亚-肩上的自由/对话ARC7-6

records.outline: After saying goodbye to Ren, I return to the training room to continue practicing, but my opponent is now Maruha. I learn that the "Highway Destroyer" is actually Ren's weapon. Where will I meet Ren again?

After completing a lucrative order, you entertain your crew and Desiree, the helper sent by COLUMBA, to go to Night Chains Land.

Desiree, whom you arranged to meet, lost contact, and you learn from the Night Chains member Margiela, whom you encounter by chance, that several incidents of teenage disappearances have happened in the amusement park.
Meanwhile, Desiree has a chance encounter with Tara, who is being harassed by a suspicious person in the amusement park. Facing this blatantly flawed scammer, the two quickly team up.
Through your efforts, the missing person's uncooperative companions provide some valuable information.
From Ren, an employee at the amusement park whom you have met once, you learn that the negative emotions of the missing people are very intense.
Margiela heard an intriguing rumor from some teenage tourists. Lin's attitude seems a bit off... and at that moment, Desiree calls.
Desiree and Tara successfully catch the kidnapper, yet the girl imprisoned by the kidnapper is nowhere to be found.
The kidnapper undergoes interrogation; however, he is not the real culprit you are pursuing.
When you are feeling stuck, the manager of the amusement park, Goethe, appears and brings important information. A survivor claimed that the culprit is the Witch.

You hear from Tara about the witch legend from the Empire and learn that the Witch is such an evil being, causing Margiela's faith to collapse. On the other hand, Masaki seems to have seen the true culprit...
There are new missing persons, and Margiela's condition is also very strange, as if under some kind of control, heading in a certain direction.
You and Margiela receive help from Arcana. After learning about her connection with the Witch of the Empire, Margiela still decides to face it all.
You all entered the divination room, and Margiela finally meets Masaki.
From Serena's mad words, you vaguely understand why she took such a path.
After witnessing Margiela's determination, Masaki also reveals everything about her past to Margiela.
After things settle down, you learn their past not as the Witch.
With Margiela's efforts, the divination room has reopened. This time, let the witch bring happiness and miracles to everyone.
Masaki boards the Eternal and requests to investigate the unknown mysterious animal in the BCRL restricted area with your help.
The UMA appears to be just a Chaos Remain, and you two decide to investigate further before reporting back.
Masaki seems a bit downcast. She confides her feelings to you, and the two of you promise to share secrets.
Masaki notices something strange about you. Limited by certain rules, she cannot tell you directly, but she still offers you her blessing.

records.idCN: 乘员逸闻/瑞瓦-恶魔狩猎委托/对话ARC9-5
records.outline: Using a clever approach, we convince the client of our explanation to help the little girl out of trouble. I conclude today's work and say goodbye to Reeva, hoping to meet her on The Eternal in the future!

The Citadel has been delaying the retrieval of Haima Zaria at Tattle Station, seemingly with other plans in mind. On this day, an Angel never seen before breaks into the Eternal, bringing new trouble...

After defeating the Phantom Raziel in Haima Zaria, Chloe expresses surprise at your completion of the deep dive and informs you of an even more shocking fact: you now seem to be the key to the transformation of the Angel Project...
A strange man claiming to be your blood kin appears before you. His words and the so-called "truth" he speaks make you feel incredibly uneasy. What does he really mean?
A salvage company recovers a mysterious box from Freeport VII. Multiple factions gather for a meeting, each harboring their own agendas as they maneuver around the Verdant Realm Project.
You arrive at Freeport VII at Medici's request. With time before your formal meeting with her, everyone chats about anecdotes concerning the President.

You and Livia meet with President Medici and learn the full story behind the commemoration. Medici's attempt to introduce Ikara doesn't go as planned; everyone discusses the speech then splits up to prepare.
You run into Ikara by the seaside. The two of you exchange pleasantries, then decide to go around together.

To get a view of the city, you head to an observation deck, where you meet someone reminiscing about the past and gather information. Ikara asks you to take a photo of her, saying she wants to show it to her guardian.
After gathering intel, you and Ikara take a break, during which she confides that she's troubled by her feelings toward Medici.
While wandering the city with Ikara, you discover a clothing store and go in to browse and shop.
You and Ikara arrive at the coast, where you find a woman acting strangely, as though about to walk into the sea. You rush to help her, but end up accidentally falling into the water together.
Once ashore, you discover it was all a misunderstanding — the woman, named Chen Shuxian, seems to have a connection to Old Freeport VII. Ikara is upset that her belongings got soaked.
While you talk, Eliade arrives, and you learn from him about the Freeport's past and the Verdant Realm Project.

Eliade tells you about the once-shelved "Verdant Realm Project," which aimed to extend the railway into the Empire. Thrilled, you readily agree when Eliade invites you to join, while also realizing Ikara might be connected to it somehow.
The group parts ways, and you invite Ikara to the Eternal to help fix her phone. Running into Livia aboard, everyone discusses preparations for the speech.
You bring up the Verdant Realm Project, then receive a call from Eliade, arranging to depart the next day.
The commemoration begins, with dignitaries giving speeches. The salvage company's head mentions the opening of the Apoaster Bridge, then announces Livia's speech has been chosen.
Livia takes the stage and delivers her speech to applause, but afterward becomes utterly exhausted. Back on the Eternal, she collapses with a high fever.
Medici, Ikara, and the salvage company's head come to visit upon hearing the news. You intend to turn down Eliade's request, but Livia stops you.
Eliade comes to meet with you, and you and Ikara set off together for the Apoaster Bridge.
Chatting along the way, you notice the photograph in Medici's hand, and learn of the connection between Ikara and Medici.
Upon arriving at the Apoaster Bridge, everyone begins preparations and launches the capture operation.
Facing the Navigator, you and Ikara come up with a plan.
You draw on Ikara's power, preparing to deliver a fatal blow to the monster.
You prepare to drive the train into the Chaos Space to fight.
Ikara reveals just a glimpse of her true power, helping everyone pursue the Chaos Remain, and a fierce battle breaks out between the two sides.
Upon entering the Chaos Space, you see what lies beyond the rift — a place like a sea of stars.
Ikara turns the tide and defeats the monster. She says she wants to become a conductor just like you.
With everything settled, Ikara bids farewell to you and sets off on her own path.

The dignitaries hold a meeting, and when the location for the Verdant Realm Academy comes up, Sagi proposes that Night Chains could provide the venue — there seems to be something special about the origins of this new school...

records.idCN: 角色试用/伊利亚德-倒翻的书/对话TE2-3
records.outline: Learning that the original schematic is in Eliade's art studio triggers memories Akira and Yer would rather not revisit — as it turns out, Eliade's paintings have quite an impact, and not one anybody is prepared for...

records.idCN: 角色试用/伊利亚德-倒翻的书/对话TE2-4
records.outline: The two of them meet the goal, and Eliade keeps his word and lets them read the handbook. There are two hands in the notebook, and that is how they brush up against a past from over twenty years ago.

records.idCN: 角色试用/伊利亚德-倒翻的书/对话TE2-5
records.outline: Guided by Eliade, the two of them take part in the last of the challenge puzzles Chu Yuheng left behind. Watching his own students, and one generation of new Gardeners after another, come into their own stirs a great deal in Eliade...

records.idCN: 角色试用/伊利亚德-倒翻的书/对话TE2-1
records.outline: Eliade plans to use a new mode in the Gardener assessments and asks Akira and Yer to help test it. The handbook he never lets out of his hands catches their curiosity.
Slokai wakes underground, forces the power of the Mechanical God to drive a drilling unit out, and crashes into an underground village.
Her drill bursts into the village bathhouse, wrecking the place and drawing a crowd of furious Grottlings. With no language in common, she is led away to wait for someone called "Breese."

At the recycling ship, Breese learns from Anfiya that an outsider from another world has appeared near his home, Atricrypta Village. Tarei bursts in wrapped in a bath towel, and the two set out at once.

Outside the Wilderness Station, Conductor and Livia reach Anfiya's coordinates to find her and a crowd of Breese-like dwarves surrounding two girls— one being Slokai... the "Miss Ellie" you've met before.
Before the dispute is settled, Slokai collapses with a raging fever, and her arm turns transparent, as though she were vanishing from this world.
Anfiya explains that the Morphic Field is rejecting Slokai— Dissociation— and that she will vanish in seven days. She asks us to find the legendary Fruit of Prima Materia to buy her time.
While the crew debates which person from the Empire to ask, Slokai wakes, tells Anfiya she understands her condition, and refuses to rest.
Rina Von tells us Katas is away, so we head to Shoggolith City to ask Olivien at the café.
At the café we meet Olivien's guardian Helena, who knows Mundus well. Meanwhile Slokai talks with Breese and agrees to help him.
Helena offers the recipe but refuses payment— instead, Livia and I must keep one promise for her someday. She will assist with the compounding herself.
Helena walks us through the five materials and the history behind the fruit.
Directing the Grottlings at their rebuilding site, Slokai wins over some of them.
We work through the riddles with Slokai, while "Bofay," their prophet, stirs controversy among the Grottlings.
Anfiya comes through on the last material. We set out for the mine and ONEderland; Slokai insists on coming.
Slokai boards the Eternal again. At the recycling ship, Breese confides his confusion to Anfiya.
At Mander Mine, Slokai takes in the industrial air in silence, familiar and strange at once. Old Baxter helps us find Silver Dust of the Star, and we move on to ONEderland.
We go to take on the Sand Phosphor, telling Slokai to stay on the train.
Livia and I finish the cactus job in ONEderland— and Slokai takes an interest in Miss Gold...

The Grottlings turn on each other over the Crucible. The chief bars outsiders from the temple, but as more of his people fall unconscious, Slokai takes the trial, vowing to answer the faith they place in her.
With Grottlings still collapsing, we decide to reach the Crucible to wake them and compound the fruit. Helena leaves without explanation; Slokai resolves to go back underground.
The road to the temple is broken. We use a zip line and a hidden mechanism to get inside.
Breese and Box ride the zip line across to activate the retractable bridge, and barely survive an ambush by a "long-eared Grottling."
Deep Sleepers and guardians in Empire clothing tie the temple to the Mundus Empire. We resolve to uncover the truth about it and the Crucible.
Deciphering the alchemist's Word-Sealing Light Shard, we solve the gemstone mechanism and open the doors to the Crucible.
We investigate the dead Crucible and its track system, find what is keeping it from starting, then follow the Midnight Bunny toward a deeper secret.

Hidden deep in the temple are the Grottlings' "true forms" and a staggering mural: they were built by the alchemist for the Empire's migration plan. Breese is left in anguish while the rest of us repair the Crucible.
Relighting the Crucible starts the track array— and rouses a powerful Chaos Remain, forcing us to flee.
Breese leads the newly woken Grottlings against it; Slokai pins it with the power of the Mechanical God and collapses. The rest of us pull back, and the crisis passes for now.
After struggling on the edge of death and dream, Slokai wakes through Helena's Fruit of Prima Materia.

records.idCN: 角色试用/海伦娜-原石考察/对话TE3-5
records.outline: Helena uses gem divination to make her stance clear to Lissandra, and tells me of the choice she once faced between watching over fate and letting a dear friend go. We then reunite with Katas and Olivien for a moment of peace.
I'm taken to a secret Citadel base after Ushana and Nayuta show up out of nowhere one night in Gronru City.
I witness Chelsea's interrogation as a "witness," watching her break down under Aviciana's drug-assisted questioning.
The interrogation exposes her contradictions; she breaks and cries out for "Father," raising the Mistletoe experiments and whether Professor is still alive.
Lissandra rules her innocent but accountable and frees her from duty — but Chelsea can't bear it, breaking down and lunging at me.
In the dream trial, my presence draws out and purges her obsession; still lost upon waking, she sets off to find herself with my encouragement.
Medici had a dream about his daughter, and this dream seemed to be an omen of something...
Medici went to Helena's jewelry store to visit; she wanted to see someone who seemed to be related to Livia.
Anita's gardeners are investigating the explosion incident, and they want to find the whereabouts of a missing researcher.
At the same time, the Citadel detected the presence of some danger...
You wake up from a nightmare, and then Ikara informs you that she will be leaving today, hoping to spend the remaining time with you exploring Gronru City.
After experiencing cycling with Ikara, you took her to the station where the guard Tistar, who came to meet you, had been waiting for a long time.
Finally reunited with the recovered Livia, your crew is once again fully assembled, awaiting new quests.
On the other side, the Gardeners who were searching around found the researcher they were looking for; however, the situation of the latter was beyond everyone's expectations.

You met a mysterious girl named D-Ramis during an unexpected encounter. With Anita's help, you avoided the biggest crisis. However, the entire crew still needs to halt for repairs for a while. You plan to take the opportunity to try out a famous restaurant in Gronru City.
According to Eliade's instructions, you arrive on time at the institute in Gronru City to participate in Anita's new employee training. There, you reunite with Doraemis and meet your mentor, Shilo.
Anethum's lectures are too dull, you and D-Ramis cannot resist the drowsiness, which makes Anethum very unhappy.
The people of Gronru City are all preparing for the upcoming fishing competition, while you and Doraemis have taken on quests assigned by Anethum and have begun the practical segment.
During the break, you discovered Dolores' special constitution. The CR seems to recognize her as one of their own and is very close to her.
You are attracted by the promotional message of the fishing competition, and at this moment, your nemesis Simon appears once again, issuing a challenge to you.

You planned to buy tickets to watch the competition, but under the persuasion of the staff, D-Ramis accidentally signed up to be a contestant, and the conditions for withdrawal are extremely strict, so you can only accept reality.

Upon learning that you were going to participate in the competition, Simon was very incredulous and decided he would also participate. With the support of Simon's mother and sister, Simon's father finally relented and agreed.

Livia was very opposed to you participating in the competition. However, after you explained the competition rules to her and mentioned that you could withdraw halfway, she finally reluctantly agreed.
You and D-Ramis are waiting for the competition to start, and everyone in Gronru City is paying close attention to this grand event.

Although initially lacking proficiency, you quickly grasp the essentials of sailing and, with Ramis' help, catch a large number of sea fish. Your impressive performance wins you considerable popularity.

The competition entered the second stage, and suddenly a mysterious monster fish appeared and began attacking the competitors. The attacked competitors turned into CR, while the audience thought it was just part of the program...
It was not easy to get the contestants to listen to you, but then you received new bad news from Shi Luo: the mastermind had actually planted bombs on your ship and in the audience seating area.
As the second round of voting ended, the host announced a new rule: eliminated contestants could be saved if they sacrificed their companions, which immediately caused new confusion.

Livia and others are trying to find a way to support you, and you are not sitting idly by either. You join forces with other contestants intending to kill the Demon Lantern Shark, but just as you are about to succeed, the forward ship is blown up, revealing the mastermind behind the scenes...
Under the instigation of Nikita, you were eliminated. Facing the pursuit of the Ghost Lantern Shark, you suddenly thought of a good idea to find Nikita's hiding place.
You are driven into desperation, and Doraemis resolutely plans to sacrifice herself to secure your way out.
Simon awakened your discouraged will, and he was also eliminated. You thought of a very risky method, and with your encouragement, Simon decided to do as you said.
Simon and Jess successfully cooperated with your plan to kill the Ghost Lantern Shark. Meanwhile, Shizuru and others also found Nikita's hiding place.
D-Ramis returned to you safe and sound, however, Nikita managed to escape and is ready for a brand new crisis...
在妮基塔挟持了新鱼记内的评委们作为人质后，贡露城内陷入混乱，铁安局内陷入紧张之中。
静流和卡莲作为谈判代表与妮基塔沟通，然而妮基塔要求只能派出一个人进入新鱼记，卡莲自告奋勇由自己前往。
你和同伴们终于来到铁安局与众人汇合，在你向海因里希汇报情况时，妮基塔也提出了她的要求。
你了解到贡露城有着特殊的现实稳定装置管理机制，为了挫败妮基塔的计划，你将与西蒙和婕丝共同完成一项特殊任务。
借助罗勒伊家族的特权，你们很顺利地搜集到第一个权限密钥。
你们遇到了第一个阻碍，对此，你们决定采取强硬一些的手段并顺利得到第二个权限密钥。
你们继续努力搜集权限密钥时，新鱼记餐厅内有评委率先屈服。
为了阻碍你的行动，妮基塔居然许以重金让全城的人来追捕你。危急时刻，有人出手相助，那个人竟然是新鱼记的主厨徐佳心。
徐佳心不惜亲自吃下污染的菜肴，成为试药志愿者。她提出愿意帮助你们说服接下来要拜访的一位美食家。
在无垠号车厢内，我们为潜入维蒂林场进行身份伪装的准备。
回忆起来自会长和的双重委托——我们既要调查两名失联的异乡来客，又要探查夏尔母亲的求救信背后的隐情，众人决定以“科伦巴商会考察团”的身份潜入这座被雾与秘密笼罩的小镇。
我们抵达雾气弥漫、戒备森严的维蒂林场，在森林中遭遇林间修会的修士并被带往镇长奥布登处；在出示推荐信后成功取得信任，夏尔以家乡女儿的身份化解疑心，但奥布登提出的林场“五条规矩”暗示着这座小镇隐藏着不为人知的危险。
我们和夏尔的母亲萝赛汇合，又见到了神秘的妹妹费雅；家庭的重逢虽温馨，却隐约透出微妙的违和与暗流。
在费雅的带领下，我们探访维蒂林场的老工坊，目睹了工匠尼尔森和独臂汉斯的精湛手艺，也了解到林场二十年前的灾难与即将到来的“归雾节”。
费雅带领我们前往赫伯特医生的诊所，希望获取汉斯的止痛药；在诊所中，赫伯特向我们揭示了灰斑症的来历——二十年前的林场灾难、慈木的诅咒以及归雾节的由来。
正当危急之际，一名身着黑色长袍的女修士带着数名修士及时出现，她们以雕刻图腾的木钉制服了病人，使其失去行动能力。
圣女赫卡蒂亲自带队带走灰斑症病人，赫伯特被警告不再挑战林间修会的耐心。
费雅带领我们悄悄跟随林间修会，试图追踪赫卡蒂处理灰斑症病人的去向，但最终未能接近。
我们回到民宅，暂时放下紧张，享受家人的温暖与晚餐。夜晚，我在床上感受到一阵眩晕并陷入梦境，看见赫卡蒂在母神慈木身旁承受着二十年前大火遗留的痛苦。
在奥布登的带领下，我们参观了林场。考察途中，我再次听见来自森林深处的呼唤，被雾气迷惑陷入昏迷，昏暗中似乎看见一名戴防毒面具的神秘人注视着我。
我和莉薇娅在雾中昏迷，被贝尔法斯特救起并带到他的隐秘小屋，他用木钉缓解了我因雾气引起的不适，随后紧急将我们送回林间，避免被他人发现。
夏尔对费雅的身份产生怀疑，但坚决表示保护家人和同伴。
夜晚回到家中，费雅汇报灰斑症骤然扩散与赫伯特的反常举动，而我在夜里病情恶化、陷入幻觉，于梦境中目睹赫卡蒂向慈木立誓要为森林降下“最终的裁夺”。
清晨，林场民宅被愤怒镇民与修会包围，赫伯特试图将我交给他研究，而费雅现身以真实之姿主动承担风险，平息众怒并被修士带走。
萝赛向我们揭示真相，解释费雅的医者本心与计划，并决定前往林间修会，寻找赫卡蒂以揭开更深的谜团。
我们潜入被浓雾笼罩的林间修会，发现修士们如同行尸般失魂落魄；赫卡蒂宣布将公开审判嘉尔，并讲述二十年前被焚祭的女祭司往事，暗示这场审判是掩护更深行动的假象。
在归雾节的审判现场，嘉尔被绑在木桩上，面对赫卡蒂宣读的三条罪状，人群投票决定她的命运。关键时刻，二十年前幸存的贝尔法斯特现身，为真相投票，扭转局势，使嘉尔免于被焚。
夏尔找到的文件揭示了降临会铺垫二十年的计划，浓雾渐起，我们急忙戴上面具奔向慈木，试图阻止降临会的仪式。
在浓雾中，我们遭遇了赫伯特——他承认把维蒂林场当作实验场、为学术牺牲镇民正名并狂热追求“发现”；夏尔愤怒扇了他一耳光后，众人无暇争辩，继续赶路。
在森林深处，嘉尔以耳羽驱散浓雾，阻止了灰斑症患者的攻击，引领小队冲向慈木所在之地。眼前的母神树慈木被极端力量腐化，赫卡蒂与慈木融为一体，愤怒的力量扭曲森林。
奥布登在母神树前揭露自己的狂信与执念，指责慈木以庇佑之名囚禁众人，宣称要借“降临仪式”夺取升构力量
赫卡蒂化身慈木，以自己的生命与形态场力量燃烧净化，将浓雾与污染彻底驱散。她承载着灰斑症患者的痛苦与希望，化作光粒散落天地，让光明重返林场。
维蒂林场恢复了平静，雾气散去，阳光照进小镇。贝尔法斯特坐镇管理中心，回顾过去的混乱与牺牲，感慨慈木的守护与付出。
赫卡蒂将继续守望世间的希冀与期盼，暂居于嘉尔身边，学习并生活于这个世界。即便失去神的指引，她仍决定践行正义。

窟灵族刚刚建成的大浴场里，一位新的异乡来客突然出现，打破了村落的平静。
迪妮莎被瑞瓦一行人带去窟灵族的小屋中休息，却仍然很难接受这个世界的种种现实。
得知回到原来的世界需要借助机体的庇护，又从窟灵族那里听说机体失踪的现实后，迪妮莎有了新的计划。
挟持了窟灵族的迪妮莎循着回到原本世界的线索一路来到无垠号，而此时的无垠号上，斯洛卡伊却发现自己已经失去了与机体尼禄的联系。
斯洛卡伊和迪妮莎进行一番互不认可的交涉后，迪妮莎沦为了斯洛卡伊所安排的“劳役人员”，要以劳动换取稳定形态场的“原质之果”。
在村落中劳动的迪妮莎态度漠然。
劳动过程中，迪妮莎发现了她喜欢的植物——香菜。得到许可后，种下了香菜的种子，迪妮莎的心情似乎轻松了一些。
村庄内散漫的生活让迪妮莎很不适应。与薇尔岚约定好第二天的工作后，迪妮莎独自休息。
在巡逻过程中，迪妮莎和薇尔岚从拾荒者手中救下了因梦游而离群的窟灵族。
前去询问情报的斯洛卡伊和莉薇娅归来，确认了斯洛卡伊的机神力并无异常，问题逐渐锁定在消失的“神圣盔甲”——尼禄一侧。
为了寻找和定位尼禄，众人进行了简短的作战会议，并且派迪妮莎外出巡逻。
迪妮莎在外出巡逻期间与魇交手，随后因为形态场波动剧烈而陷入昏迷。窟灵族强行要求迪妮莎收下原质之果，而迪妮莎则下定了一定要解决事件的决心。
Slokai wakes underground, forces the power of the Mechanical God to drive a drilling unit out, and crashes into an underground village.
吃下原质之果的迪妮莎回归正常，循着窟灵族们消失的方向，我们重新开始追踪尼禄的踪迹。
飙车赶回汇合地点的途中，我们意外获得了魇的协助。好在准备已经完成，现在只待捕捉尼禄！
我与迪妮莎驱车前去窟灵族消失的方向，终于在荒废地区的边缘找到了尼禄的踪迹，但却被尼禄反向追踪。
斯洛卡伊与魇都参与了捕获尼禄的作战。在再次寻找尼禄的途中，迪妮莎表示对目前的情况有些不适应。在各自的思绪和目的中，我们继续前进。
在困难的战斗之后，我们终于按照预定完成了作战，使尼禄停下了行动。但环顾四周，却少了迪妮莎的身影——
剧烈的形态场波动导致了空间错乱，迪妮莎来到了某个似曾相识的地方——与她记忆中的某处相似的场所。
关于“神圣盔甲”尼禄的事故告一段落，度假村的建设再次回到正轨。只是，这里多了一位名叫迪妮莎的“工作人员”……
意识沉在很深的地方......
又过了两日，你身体好转，鹊儿带你到书房，讲述两人从小一起长大的往事。她讲得绘声绘色，你虽无记忆，但逐渐在脑中形成了这些画面的轮廓。
鹊儿带你第一次走出踏枝山庄，游览街道。沿途遇到的街坊邻居——点心铺张婶、绸缎庄李掌柜——都热情地与你打招呼。你发现街边贴着一张通缉令，通缉一名黑衣剑客，还有一个归乡客登记处的告示。
鹊儿带你到西湖边，遥望白妃塔。她讲述了武林的传说：西湖底下沉睡着一条龙君，翻身会引发汛期，淹没城市。白妃塔是鹊儿的姐姐所建，用以镇压龙君。她说武林的婚礼能凝聚人心、稳住城市，你们的婚礼就是为了冲喜、抵御汛期。
突然出现的精怪被及时赶到的巡案使美琪击退。美琪是钱府尹的义女，负责巡查西湖一带。她说自己也在追查那个黑衣剑客的下落。临别时，美琪注意到你掌心的茧，神色有异。
傍晚回到踏枝山庄，你答应完成婚约。鹊儿告知婚礼需走三书六礼的流程——纳采、问名、纳吉、纳征、请期、亲迎，十五日内全部走完。
你去府衙办理问名之礼。钱府尹的态度十分客气，甚至对鹊儿有些过分恭敬。美琪带你到户房查看户籍记录，发现一份归乡登记册上，你的名字旁边有一个被擦掉的莉字。
你到市集买纳吉用的木雁，隔壁铁匠老赵认出你，说上个月你在他这儿打过一把双面开刃的匕首。但按鹊儿的说法，你那时还在仙洲未归。老赵被自己的记忆搞糊涂了，鹊儿恰好出现，三言两语把话题带了过去。
纳吉仪式在西湖边举行，钱府尹主持。供桌上的香烛无风自灭，鹊儿若无其事地重新点燃。湖水中再次涌出大量精怪袭击观礼人群。鹊儿情急之下使用了观澜阁法术。
精怪击退后，黑衣剑客现身，救了被压在竹棚下的孩子和老妪，治好了孩子的伤口。你与她隔空对视，心中涌起强烈的情绪共鸣。鹊儿抢先指着黑衣剑客高喊她就是引发汛期的元凶……
回到踏枝山庄后，鹊儿向你解释今天的失态。你表示会完成婚礼，两人在沉默中达成了一种心照不宣的默契。
美琪来到虎跃堂，她调查后发现武林的人口登记极其反常——没有新生儿记录，没有外来者，归乡客的档案就像旧瓶装新酒。
纳征前夜，你在踏枝山庄与鹊儿聊天。她提起姐姐说过的往事。你安慰她，她却忽然情绪失控，匆匆离开了房间。
纳征当日，仪式在西湖边举行。就在这时，一个巨大的类人型怪物从水中出现——它有着人类的外形，但浑身被桦树般的角质覆盖，手持一柄禅杖。鹊儿认出那是守塔人怒海，她第一次在你面前露出了真正的惊恐与慌乱。
战后你追问鹊儿那个怪物的来历，她终于承认婚礼确实能暂缓危机，但效果正在递减——纳吉时出了精怪，纳征时塔裂了、守塔人变成了怪物。她第一次在你面前卸下所有伪装，承认自己不知道该怎么办了。你告诉她你会完成婚约。
傍晚回到踏枝山庄。你在归途中发现了黑衣剑客留下的瓦片记号，顺着指引独自折返虎跃堂，在后院的暗格里找到了一个铁皮箱子，里面似乎放着重要的东西……
你在西湖边遇见美琪。她通过钱府尹的藏书室找到了一份初代府尹的手札，记载着观澜阁的蜃楼之术。美琪离开后你独自走近白妃塔，触摸塔身上的刻纹时，一段不属于你的记忆涌入了你的意识——
婚礼当日。桂雨轩张灯结彩，你在礼台上见到了身着嫁衣的鹊儿。司仪按武林习俗问了一句"可有人异议"——一道剑气从天而降，劈断了你们之间的红绸。黑衣剑客从廊台上现身，清晰地说出那四个字："我不同意。"
莉薇娅从廊台跃下，走到你和鹊儿面前。鹊儿试图维持礼数，但莉薇娅不给她台阶下。鹊儿终于意识到自己藏了几十年的秘密已经被你彻底看穿。
鹊儿承认了自己的能力——她通过心理暗示封存和改写记忆，给归乡客们安排新的身份。她辩解说自己给了他们一个不用逃避末世的地方。你说他们应该有选择的权利，她说那种东西她自己都没有。莉薇娅告诉她，正因为她已经拥有了"心"成为了一个完整的人，所以姐姐才会选择代替她入塔。这时怒潮的天威再次现身。你们意识到真正的危机不是龙君苏醒，而是白妃塔内部出了问题导致形态污染失控——必须先击败眼前的敌人。
击败怒潮的天威后过了几日。武林渐渐恢复了平静，蜃楼的限制被解除。
你和莉薇娅去踏枝山庄向鹊儿道别。你们约定等各自处理好手头的事就一起进入白妃塔。

多萝西和伊洛娜来到孤儿院举办铁盟组织的安全教育活动，在那里认识了一个友善的志愿者女孩。然而，第二天早上醒来的时候，她们却双双变成了孩子的身体。
我们回到多萝西家中进行休整。在和洛娅女士谈话以后，我们仍然不想放弃，决定在保证安全的前提下继续调查。
在孤儿院遗迹地下的防灾设施内，我们找到了爱弥儿。但她坚持认为孩子的生活才是最幸福的，不肯答应把受害者们变回来的请求。
变成孩子的多萝西和伊洛娜得到了多萝西的母亲洛娅的帮助和安慰，开始面对现实，商量接下来的计划。
我接到通讯便赶到多萝西家中，亲眼见证了这个不可思议的场面——随后，我们决定开始调查此事。
我们去往前一天的孤儿院，然而工作人员的态度却有些模棱两可，似乎要尽力隐瞒什么。
在向工作人员问话的过程中，我们得知“变小”的人并非只有多萝西和伊洛娜二人。此时转机突现，静流作为来调查的铁盟人员出现在了孤儿院门口。
在静流的协助下，调查过程有了明确的目标。我们开始询问其他的变小化受影响者，最终找到了可能的线索。
我们按照地址来到一家看起来废弃了一段时间的店铺，却在那里遇见了一个“鬼魂”。
梳理情报以后，我们确定鬼魂的真身是昨天二人遇见的志愿者女孩，是一个升构者。静流打来通讯，表示铁盟会接手此事，建议二人回家休息。
结合伊洛娜的高超信息处理技术，我们锁定了爱弥儿的真正活动和居住地点。
在爱弥儿的居住地点外，我们让变小的监视机器人通过敞开的窗户溜进房间，发现了由爱弥儿留下、精心设计的“布景”。
公寓内的布景似乎反映了某个人的成长轨迹，最终，我们一路回溯到一座已被拆除的孤儿院遗迹之外。
多萝西对爱弥儿的态度表示理解，但伊洛娜却表示自己绝不想被困在儿童的身体中。意见冲突之后，两位好朋友重新达成理解，并肩戳破了爱弥儿美好的幻想。
被指出错误的爱弥儿陷入精神崩溃。她的升构能力失控导致了周围形态污染数值剧烈变化，甚至打开了位于附近的桦树空间入口，导致桦树生物涌入。
在混乱的情况下，我们难以脱身。伊洛娜决定铤而走险，通过遵守爱弥儿的游戏规则、重新玩一次捉迷藏的方式，让爱弥儿从混乱的情况下清醒过来。
在爱弥儿创造的混乱空间之中，我们观看到了爱弥儿的过去。最终，我们找到了那个被困在数十年尚未结束的捉迷藏中的孩子——
从桦树空间中脱离的爱弥儿打算结束自己的生命。但在外待命已久的甘雅赶到，阻止了悲剧的发生。在外面，还有很多关心着我们的人在等待我们回去。
事件告一段落，我在铁安局又见到了静流，得知了事情的全貌。与此同时，铁安局的会面室内，尚未变回去的多萝西和伊洛娜在拜访爱弥儿……
